```json
 "topology": "3-stage NMOS-starved ring oscillator with CMOS output buffer",
 "rationale": "Ring is three stages for the highest speed. VCTRL drives the NMOS starving gates directly, so there is no bias branch and no reference power. At 0.7 V the starvers are near threshold; at 1.4 V they are strongly on. The fall delay therefore varies more than 30x, and the period runs from starved-edge limited to inverter limited. Switched capacitance is about 30 fF, which puts power near 0.4 mW at 2.4 GHz. A rail-to-rail inverter buffer drives the CL load."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I_mid":   (70e-6, 25e-6, 200e-6),   # starving current per stage at mid vctrl
    "Ls":      (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),         # starver L (longer -> more square-law, wider tuning)
    "Wn_inv":  (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),         # ring inverter NMOS width
    "p_ratio": (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),          # ring inverter Wp/Wn
    "Wn_buf":  (1.5, 0.42, 6.0),         # output buffer NMOS width
    "pb_ratio":(2.5, 1.0, 5.0),          # buffer Wp/Wn
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    VDD = 1.8
    Lmin = 0.15
    Ls = p["Ls"]

    # starver sized to deliver I_mid at vgs=vmid (vds ~0.35 V while discharging)
    unit = lut.op("n", 1.0, Ls, vmid, 0.35)
    Ws = max(0.42, p["I_mid"] / max(unit["Id"], 1e-12))
    ms = max(1, int(math.ceil(Ws / 20.0)))

    Wn = p["Wn_inv"]; Wp = Wn * p["p_ratio"]
    Wnb = p["Wn_buf"]; Wpb = Wnb * p["pb_ratio"]

    # node capacitance: next-stage gate + own drains (+ starver-internal node share)
    opn = lut.op("n", Wn, Lmin, 0.9, 0.9); opp = lut.op("p", Wp, Lmin, 0.9, 0.9)
    cg_inv = opn["cgg"] + opp["cgg"]
    cd = 1.0e-15 * (Wn + Wp)
    Cn = cg_inv + cd + 1.0e-15
    opnb = lut.op("n", Wnb, Lmin, 0.9, 0.9); oppb = lut.op("p", Wpb, Lmin, 0.9, 0.9)
    Cn0 = Cn + opnb["cgg"] + oppb["cgg"]          # node driving the buffer

    # pull-up current (unstarved PMOS)
    Ipu = lut.op("p", Wp, Lmin, VDD, 0.9)["Id"]
    Ipd_inv = lut.op("n", Wn, Lmin, VDD, 0.5)["Id"]

    def freq(vc):
        Is = lut.op("n", Ws, Ls, vc, 0.35)["Id"]
        Ipd = 1.0 / (1.0 / max(Is, 1e-12) + 1.0 / max(Ipd_inv, 1e-12))
        Cavg = (2 * Cn + Cn0) / 3.0
        tf = Cavg * 0.5 * VDD / Ipd
        tr = Cavg * 0.5 * VDD / max(Ipu, 1e-12)
        return 1.0 / (3.0 * (tf + tr) * 1.4)        # 1.4: slope/overlap fudge

    f_lo, f_mid, f_hi = freq(vlo), freq(vmid), freq(vhi)

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    nodes = ["r0", "r1", "r2"]
    for i in range(3):
        a = nodes[i]; y = nodes[(i + 1) % 3]
        n.M(f"MP{i}", y, a, "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lmin)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", y, a, f"s{i}", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Lmin)
        n.M(f"MS{i}", f"s{i}", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Ws, Ls, m=ms)
    # output buffer
    n.M("MPB", "vout", "r0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wpb, Lmin)
    n.M("MNB", "vout", "r0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wnb, Lmin)

    cl = spec.get("cl", 20e-15)
    Csw = 2 * Cn + Cn0 + cl + 1e-15 * (Wnb + Wpb)
    power = 1.3 * f_mid * Csw * VDD * VDD           # 1.3: crowbar current
    kvco = (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo)

    return n, {"f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
               "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
               "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
               "kvco": kvco, "swing": 0.97 * VDD, "power": power}
```
